newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's may up St George, Advance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's may up St George, Advance.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has placed the long-term ratings of St George Bank and Advance Bank and its subsidiary Bank of South Australia on review for possible upgrade.
All three banks' senior debt and deposit ratings are Baa1.
Moody's also placed the bank financial strength ratings (currently C) of St. George, Advance Bank, and Bank of South Australia under review for possible upgrade.
Moody's review follows the announcement that St. George Bank signed an agreement to acquire Advance Bank.
The A$2.7 billion acquisition will be financed by approximately 70 percent stock and 30 percent cash.
Moody's stated that the review will focus on the combined franchise of the two companies, as well as the pro forma financial strength and risk profile.
The following ratings were placed on review for possible upgrade:

St George Bank -- the Baa1 rating of the bank for long-term deposits; the Baa1 counterparty rating; the Baa1 rating for long term senior debt; Baa2 for subordinated dbet and the C rating for bank financial strength.

Advance Bank Australia Limited -- the Baa1 rating of the bank for long-term deposits; the Baa1 counterparty rating, the Baa1 rating for long term senior debt; Baa2 for subordinated debt and the C rating for bank financial strength.
Bank of South Australia -- the Baa1 rating of the bank for long-term deposits; and the C rating for bank financial strength rating.
St. George Bank -- the Prime-2 rating of the bank for short-term deposits
Advance Bank Australia Limited -- the Prime-2 rating of the bank for short-term deposits
Bank of South Australia -- the Prime-2 rating of the bank for short-term deposits.
